events.verdict: Sarr (WAS) releases away from Camara (POR) as he separates from the contact.
Camara (POR) goes to, not through Sarr's (WAS) space as they come together during the drive.
Camara (POR) is bracing for the contact from Sarr (WAS) and does not restrict his ability to defend the shot.
George (WAS) establishes himself in Sharpe's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Sarr (WAS) is moving alongside Holiday's (POR) path and Holiday dribbles the ball off his own foot.
Sarr (WAS) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Holiday's (POR) hand that is on the ball, as he defends the shot attempt.
Coulibaly (WAS) moves alongside Avdija's (POR) path as he defends the drive.
George (WAS) deflects the ball away from Avdija (POR).
Grant (POR) initiates contact with George's (WAS) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Camara (POR) establishes himself in Carrington's (WAS) path prior to the contact.
Holiday (POR) deflects the ball away from Middleton (WAS).
Carrington's (WAS) shot attempt does not touch the rim prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
George (WAS) initiates contact with Sharpe's (POR) upper body that affects his SQBR.
Camara (POR) commits a take foul on George (WAS).
Sharpe (POR) is bracing for the contact from Watkins (WAS) and he releases away from the contact.

Watkins (WAS) directly contests Sharpe's (POR) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Sharpe's (POR) hand after the release. Sharpe extends his leg outward towards Watkins, who would have otherwise avoided making any lower body contact with Sharpe during his contest.
Camara (POR) commits a take foul on Middleton (WAS).
George (WAS) legally contests Sharpe's (POR) jump shot attempt.
